perspective/session_smoke.description: Opens a Perspective project's client URL and verifies a session starts and a page actually renders. Designed to work with no login against public / anonymous projects (the bundled test-project/ToolboxAudit is built this way) while still attempting a best-effort login if the target project is secured. Steps 4-6 (the login fill/submit) are intentionally optional: they are marked on_failure=continue and are EXPECTED to report a non-fatal failure (selector not found) when run against an anonymous project like ToolboxAudit, since there is no login form to fill in. That is correct behaviour, not a bug - the overall execution still completes and the real assertions (steps 2, 7) still pass.
perspective/session_smoke.author: Nigel G

perspective/page_crawl.description: Walks a small, fixed set of Perspective page-config routes, screenshotting each and running perspective.discover_page to inventory its components. NOTE on page_paths: the playbook engine has no loop/foreach construct (a playbook's step list is static), so this cannot dynamically iterate an arbitrary comma-separated list at runtime. `page_paths` is kept as a documented, human-readable summary of what this build crawls (shown in logs/reports); the actual navigation targets are the indexed parameters page1_path and page2_path below, which must be kept in sync with page_paths. To crawl more pages, duplicate the 3-step block (navigate / wait / screenshot / discover) for a page3_path, etc.
perspective/page_crawl.author: Nigel G

perspective/navigation_audit.description: Verifies that a Perspective project's page-config navigation actually works: each configured page-config route renders directly, and the in-app navigation button on the Home page drives the client to the expected route and back. Built against the bundled test-project (`test-project/ToolboxAudit/`), whose Home view has a button ("GoToPage2Button", at data-component-path C.0:2) that calls system.perspective.navigate(page="/page2"), and whose Page2 view has a mirror button ("BackHomeButton", also C.0:2 in its own tree) that navigates back to "/". NOTE on step-type choice: perspective.verify_navigation is used to assert the client URL actually changed after each navigation (it checks page.url against expected_url_pattern after settling to networkidle) - a stronger check than browser.wait alone, which only confirms *some* Perspective view rendered, not that it is the *expected* one. NOTE on page_paths: as in page_crawl.yaml, the engine has no loop construct, so page1_path/page2_path are the actual navigation targets; page_paths is a human-readable summary only - keep both in sync.
perspective/navigation_audit.author: Nigel G

perspective/visual_baseline.description: Captures a deterministically-named, full-page screenshot set for every configured page-config route, for before/after visual comparison (e.g. before and after a customer's remediation of audit findings, or before and after an Ignition/module upgrade). Screenshot filenames incorporate baseline_name so two runs with different baseline_name values (e.g. "before" and "after") produce non-colliding, diffable sets in the screenshots directory (browser.screenshot writes "<name>.<format>" under the manager's screenshots_dir - see ignition_toolkit/browser/manager.py `screenshot()`). NOTE on page_paths: as in page_crawl.yaml, the engine has no loop construct, so page1_path/page2_path are the actual navigation targets; page_paths is a human-readable summary only - keep both in sync.
perspective/visual_baseline.author: Nigel G
